title: Rate Limiter
prompt: Design a distributed rate limiter that protects a public API. Limits are configurable per user / API key (e.g. 100 requests per minute). Requests over the limit are rejected. The limiter runs across many API servers.
functionalReqs: Limit requests per client key (user, IP or API key) per time window
Reject over-limit requests with a clear error
nonFunctionalReqs: Highly available: limiter failure must not take down the API

scale.storage: Counter state only: ~100 B per key per window

outOfScope: DDoS protection at the network layer
deepDives: Token bucket vs sliding window trade-offs
Atomic counters in Redis with Lua scripts
Fail-open vs fail-closed when Redis is down
